verdict.rationale: GlitchTip has no documented bulk-export feature. It does give users its own routes to their data: it is open source and self-hostable on standard PostgreSQL, so self-hosted users hold their data in an open database. It is also Sentry-API-compatible and has a built-in MCP server for pulling error, performance and log data into other tools. Hosted users get only documented deletion, not export. missing for 10: a documented export of all data (issues, events, logs, performance) in open formats for hosted users, a documented migration or exit path, independent corroboration that full export works.
